cmd_scripts.title: Complete Network Stack & DNS Reset
cmd_scripts.command: ipconfig /flushdns && ipconfig /release && ipconfig /renew && netsh winsock reset && netsh int ip reset
cmd_scripts.description: Flushes DNS resolver cache, releases/renews DHCP IP lease, and resets Winsock catalog.

cmd_scripts.title: Restart Printer Spooler & Clear Queue
cmd_scripts.command: net stop spooler && del /Q /F /S "%systemroot%\System32\Spool\Printers\*.*" && net start spooler
cmd_scripts.description: Stops printer spooler, deletes stuck print jobs in queue, and restarts service.
